company.name: LunchBox
company.shortDescription: LunchBox is an app that customizes a healthy lunch box for kids in preschool.
company.description:
LunchBox is a virtual food service based on a smartphone and web application that enables users to choose, customize, and combine a variety of food items into lunch box style meals for kids to be delivered at home or at school.

It was founded in 2017 and is based in Amman, Jordan.
